purpose: Compact cross-check packet comparing the freshly-derived ocg-jp 1999-08-25 release-cutoff pool against the independent YGOPRODeck "1999 Tokyo Dome Card Pool" community cube (docs/research/ocg1999-tokyo-dome-community-candidates.json); not canonical pool data.

source.title: 1999 Tokyo Dome Card Pool (370 cards) - YGOPRODeck
source.extraction_method: HTML scrape: every Name anchor on the rendered cube page.

adjudication_summary: Zero differences after canonicalization: the ledger-derived 370-card pool and the community cube's 370 candidate identities are exactly the same set of canonical passcodes. Four community entries print BabelCDB artwork-variant passcodes (distance <10 from their base, category: alias/artwork canonicalization) where this ledger's own printings record the base passcode directly: Final Flame (cube 73134082, base 73134081), Ultimate Offering (cube 80604092, base 80604091), Harpie's Feather Duster (cube 18144507, base 18144506), Monster Reborn (cube 83764719, base 83764718). Each collapses to the same canonical identity as the ledger's own printing of that card and is not counted as a real difference. RECERTIFICATION NOTE (2026-08): this comparison was independently RE-DERIVED after the 2026-08 recertification corrected two Game Guide promo dates and deleted a fabricated 1999-02-21 physical-release product (see coverage.json ocg-jp window note and the gate doc's 'recertification' section) - it is not carried over from before correction. The corrected pool is still exactly 370 cards with an unchanged digest and the same 4 raw differences, because none of the corrections changed which cards were available before the cutoff, only which product/date backs some of them. This equality is a reproducible fact about the corrected ledger, not evidence used to decide what belongs in it: the community cube was never consulted while researching or correcting any product/date, and no release record was added, removed, or altered to force this match.

raw_passcode_differences.purpose: The 4 cases above, before canonicalization, for exact reproducibility.
